1. Test Equipment Used During Trials

Multi-meter, Lux meter

cells.value: 3.4.1 Technical/ functional description including that at PCB and component level.
3.4.3 Preventive maintenance routines/ repair instructions manual along with drawings.
3.4.9 List of onboard and B&D spares.
3.4.10 Performance figure including MTBF and MTTR.
3.4.12 Certificate for low voltage (5.6 V) battery protection.
Check availability of tally and diagram plates.
Check all incoming supply cables and internal wiring end connection are provisioned with bolted type terminals and crimped lugs/ sockets of electrolytic copper.
Check for the availability of cable entry glands.
Check for the provision of automatic 'Boost' and 'Trickle' charge modes.
Check for the provision of over charge protection.
Ensure maintenance free leak proof, Sealed Ni-mh (Nickel Metal Hydride) battery of 6 volts 4.5 AH is used in AEL with proper securing arrangement.
Overall dimensions not exceeding to – L x W x H = 260 x 140 x 120 mm.
Check Input Supply Voltage. 115/127/230 V, 50/60 Hz, 1PH.
Testing by Test Push: – Press the Test push button for checking operational state of battery/ lamp.
Instantaneous automatic switching ON/ OFF AEL in case of failure of main supply.
Ensure power LED should provide 'Reflected angled beam illumination' to avoid eye blindness & direct visibility of LEDs.
Ensure Lux value of LED source > 40 Lux measured at a distance of 1 meter.
Battery Fault Indication. Ensure red LED flickers when the battery become dead or battery is removed.

Check for sufficient illumination of AEL's in all compartments including machinery spaces, workshops, galley and associated areas/ Passage ways to indicate exit routes from enclosed spaces to weather deck in case of partial power failure / Total power failure.
